lessons.trigger: Notification regarding unquoted securities (ASX Appendix 3B or equivalent) at a stock 50%+ below its 12-month high with below-average pre-announcement volume (<0.7x), where the filing is not flagged market sensitive and no companion quotation application or operational announcement is filed on the same day
lessons.rule: A standalone unquoted-securities notification without a companion quotation application can signal that previously issued but unquoted shares (e.g. from a prior private placement) are about to become quotable — the prospective arrival of new freely tradeable paper into a thinly traded, deeply de-rated register is a dilution-overhang signal; lean bearish rather than neutral when no operational catalyst accompanies the filing, because the dominant near-term mechanic is supply arriving into a thin market.

lessons.trigger: Appointment of a named financial adviser announced (not flagged market sensitive) at a stock at or near a multi-month low with volume running >1.5x average, where the adviser role is not specified as a capital raise mandate
lessons.rule: A financial adviser appointment into above-average volume at a depressed stock is a pre-transaction signal that corporate value-crystallisation activity (asset sale, merger, or strategic review) is being formally structured — the adviser appointment is the public confirmation that a process is live; lean bullish rather than neutral when volume is elevated and the stock is at a multi-month low, because the base rate for adviser appointments at distressed companies is weighted toward value-realisation transactions rather than dilutive raises, and the elevated volume suggests informed positioning ahead of an anticipated announcement.

lessons.trigger: Market-sensitive sampling commencement announcement (surface, soil, or channel) at a near-zero-liquidity junior explorer (median daily turnover effectively A$0/day) with below-average pre-announcement volume (<0.7x), stock 50%+ below its 12-month high
lessons.rule: A market-sensitive sampling-commencement filing at a near-zero-liquidity stock with suppressed volume is not equivalent to L002's neutral programme-statement default — the market-sensitive flag signals management regards the specific programme as price-relevant (new target, re-started programme, or JV-triggered activity), and at near-zero absolute liquidity even a single informed buyer creates a disproportionate price move; lean neutral-to-bullish rather than neutral when the flag is present and the stock has near-zero liquidity with suppressed pre-announcement volume, because the sell-the-news risk is minimal and the flag implies substantive body content.

lessons.trigger: Severe quantitative revenue or operational deterioration announcement (e.g. revenue down >50% year-on-year) at a stock already at a 12-month low with near-zero liquidity and heavily suppressed pre-announcement volume (<0.3x average), where the headline contains no mitigating language
lessons.rule: Before calling bearish on an extreme negative metric at a near-zero-liquidity stock already priced for maximum distress, ask whether the market has already fully discounted a going-concern scenario and whether the suppressed volume signals that all motivated sellers have already exited — when a stock is at its 12-month low with near-zero liquidity and volume is deeply suppressed, the marginal seller may already be gone and a relief-buying or short-covering reaction to even catastrophic news is possible; default to neutral rather than bearish when the de-rating is already extreme, liquidity is effectively zero, and pre-announcement volume confirms no fresh distribution is occurring.
